subject: Onboarding accelerator + integration scope
messages:
From: Eric Norton <eric.norton@healthstack.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding accelerator + integration scope

Vivek,

Thanks for the proposal this morning — HealthStack is excited about the pilot. A few follow-ups from the product and procurement teams:

- The onboarding accelerator (2-week dedicated onboarding + runbook) looks great; can you include 40 hours of custom integration to connect our event bus to Redwood's ingestion pipeline? Our engineers estimate ~30–40 hours of dev work.
- We'd like pricing to come in at or below $95k total for year 1 (license + onboarding + support).
- Procurement will need a redline-friendly SOW and preferred payment terms net 45.

I attached our LOI.

Thanks —
Eric
Eric Norton
Head of Platform, HealthStack
eric.norton@healthstack.io

Attachment: LOI-HealthStack.pdf (stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Norton <eric.norton@healthstack.io>
Cc: HealthStack Procurement <procurement@healthstack.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding accelerator + integration scope

Eric — thanks for the clear notes. We can support the 2-week onboarding accelerator and include a custom integration block. A few items to flag up front:

- Standard integration block is 16 hours. The 40-hour request is outside standard scope and would be billed as professional services.
- To meet your $95k target we would need to apply a 28% one-time discount on the year-1 list to bring the all-in number close. That discount requires deal desk executive approval due to pricing policy and the extended PS scope.
- Payment net 45 is workable; Legal will redline the SOW and confirm.

I attached a draft SOW and a pricing summary for your review. If this looks aligned, I'll escalate internally for approval and come back with an approved SOW + redlines.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

Attachments: HS-Redwood-SOW-draft-v2.docx (stub), pricing_summary_RDW-2391.xlsx (stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding accelerator + integration scope — approval request (RDW-2391)

Team — forwarding HealthStack asks and our proposed commercial. Need an exec decision: 28% one-time discount to hit $95k and approval to include 40 hours of PS as part of a bundled onboarding waiver. Key points:

- ARR/license year-1 ARR = $82,000 list before discount; with onboarding & PS the total list is $132,000. HealthStack's target is $95k all-in.
- Margin impact: at 28% discount + 40 PS hours (billable cost ~ $8k), gross margin drops below our threshold for standard deals.
- Strategic rationale: HealthStack is a mid-market SaaS vertical prospect in the digital health space; potential references + EU expansion interest.
- Risks: non-standard SOW language on change requests; we should cap custom PS hours and require change-order process.

Requesting:
1) Executive price exception to allow 28% one-time discount on year-1 fees.
2) Approval to include up to 40 hours of custom integration in the initial purchase, with clause to cap additional work and standard hourly PS rates after that.

Docs attached: SOW draft + pricing summary + LOI.

I'll summarize decisions for Legal and Procurement once we have sign-off.

Thanks,
Vivek

> Attachments: HS-Redwood-SOW-draft-v2.docx, pricing_summary_RDW-2391.xlsx, LOI-HealthStack.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding accelerator + integration scope — approval request (RDW-2391)

Vivek — thanks for the clear ask and the economics. Quick clarifying items before I take to EVP:

- Can you confirm expected 3-year customer LTV (renewal assumptions)?
- Proposed contractual language for cap-on-hours and change-order workflow (one paragraph is fine).
- Any required SLA exceptions? HealthStack mentioned onboarding SLA; are they asking for a higher SLA target or a response-time commitment?

I can aggregate and present to the EVP tonight if we have the above. Otherwise, please add a one-line business justification for the strategic value.

Marissa
Director, Deal Desk — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

> On Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 08:45 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Team — forwarding HealthStack asks and our proposed commercial. Need an exec decision...

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding accelerator + integration scope — approval request (RDW-2391)

Team — reviewed. Approve with conditions.

1) Approve one-time 28% discount on year-1 fees to meet the $95k all-in target.
2) Approve inclusion of up to 40 hours of custom integration in the initial engagement only if we add the following contractual protections:
   - Cap: 40 hours included; additional work billed at standard PS hourly rate.
   - Change-order clause: all scope changes must be submitted in writing and approved before work begins.
   - Deliverable acceptance criteria and a joint sign-off step after onboarding.
3) No SLA exceptions beyond standard onboarding timelines. Any SLA credits require a separate escalation.
4) Legal to handle redlines to payment terms; Procurement net 45 acceptable with a one-time prepay option if needed.

Marissa — please capture this language and circulate an amended SOW and a one-paragraph business rationale for the contract file: reference potential EU expansion and vertical credibility with digital-health references.

Monica Patel
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Norton <eric.norton@healthstack.io>
Cc: HealthStack Procurement <procurement@healthstack.io>, legal@healthstack.io
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding accelerator + integration scope

Eric — good news: Leadership approved the requested pricing and scope with a few contractual conditions. Summary of the approved terms:

- Total all-in year-1 price: $95,000 (one-time 28% discount applied).
- Included: 2-week onboarding accelerator + up to 40 hours of custom integration work.
- Additional integration hours billed at our standard PS hourly rate per SOW.
- Change-order clause and deliverable acceptance required before additional work begins.
- Payment: Net 45 as requested; Legal will circulate redlines to the SOW and Master Services Agreement.

Next steps:
1) Legal will send a redline to the attached SOW (expect 24–48 hours).
2) Once SOW is signed, professional services schedule and onboarding calendar will be confirmed; please nominate an engineer owner on your side.

Appreciate the partnership — excited to get HealthStack running.

Best,
Vivek
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
